ports.note: Takes a point layer of cases, each with a date, and gives back the clusters it reports as circles: one polygon per cluster, carrying its days, places, observed and expected cases, likelihood ratio and p-value.

ontology.note: GAP, meaning no mapping to an external vocabulary. fw:SpaceTimeScan and fw:ScanCluster are declared in ontology/runtime.ttl with their properties. The receipt names the date column, the unit, the study period, every record not scanned and why, the limits, the replications, the seed and the random stream, and every cluster reported with its counts and p-value.

changes.description: The test runs in the Rust kernel (TODO 17, step 3; the practitioner, 2026-11-14: "Move scan to kernel"): the seeded shuffles, bit for bit the same stream, and each shuffle's highest score, by the same arithmetic, with the same early stop. The places, the circles and the observed scan stay in the script. Hagelloch, in Node: the scan 5.4 s to 3.4 s, the day-by-day replay 18.5 s to 8.3 s, the same answer.

evidence.note: tests/space-time-scan.test.mjs (7 unit checks, the replay and the note among them) and tests/hagelloch-cluster-example.browser.mjs on Chromium, which checks both progress bars, the replay's first flagged day and the reference in References.
